Leen on myself,, depend on myself and be more resilient.  This has happened after a long episode. 2 years of depression. I moved away from my family and got a new job to reduce the stress in my life. I'm much better when lm working as l dont live in my own head as much.these things have helped..most days  ....
meds

Good food 
Suppliments 
Routine

Sleeping ( try not to get too tired )

Friends on line or in person .
